title: Coral reef tipping points: a synthetic coral–macroalgae–herbivore resilience model
description: A coral–macroalgae–herbivore model built with synthetic data to test a resilience-analysis workflow: bifurcation and basin analysis, stochastic transitions, early-warning signals, Lyapunov estimates, parameter estimation, identifiability, global sensitivity and management scenarios. Interactive website: https://dolaposalim.github.io/macroalgae_analysis_advance/
